name: Property income
note_A: property income payable is overwhelmingly interest on public debt; also holds rent (imperfect)
note_B: parent spanning interest, dividends and rent; no single node
adjudication_note: D4 spans interest, distributed income, reinvested earnings and rent on land/subsoil; EXP_DebtService is defined narrowly as interest on sovereign debt. Mapping the heterogeneous parent to the interest leaf is a closest-node stretch, not a denotation. Ruled with B.

name: Property income, of which payable to subsector S1311
note_A: 'of which' counterparty slice of D4; counterparty is a dimension
note_B: counterparty memo split of an aggregate; consolidation dimension, not an account
adjudication_note: 'of which payable to subsector S13xx' is a counterparty memo split of an aggregate, not a separate account. Kontablo models counterparty as an elimination attribute (LocalEntry.intercompany_with), never as a node, so no leaf denotes it. It remains the parent's aggregate viewed through a counterparty axis -- ruled AGGREGATE, matching neither labeler: A mapped it to a leaf (too aggressive), B ruled it wholly out of scope (too strict, since Kontablo does represent it as a computed rollup).

name: Social benefits other than social transfers in kind and social transfers in kind - purchased market production
note_A: both constituents denote social benefits expense, so the bundle denotes that one node
note_B: combination spanning a mapped (D62) and an unmapped (D632) item
adjudication_note: Combined code spanning D62 (maps to EXP_SocialBenefitsExpense) and D632 (ruled out of scope above). A bundle spanning a mapped and an unmapped constituent cannot denote the single leaf. Ruled with B.

name: Social transfers in kind - purchased market production
note_A: social transfers in kind purchased from market producers = benefit expense in kind
note_B: social transfer in kind (purchased market output); outside IPSAS 42 cash-benefit node
adjudication_note: D632 is government purchase of market output delivered to households. The node's declared anchor IPSAS 42 scopes to cash social benefits and excludes transfers in kind, but the node's own examples list 'Healthcare subsidies to population', which is exactly this. The drafted node is internally inconsistent between its ipsas_ref and its examples -- recorded as a defect of the extension. Ruled on the declared standard anchor (empty), with B.

name: Acquisitions less disposals of non-financial non-produced assets
note_A: net acquisitions of land/subsoil/licences; movement rolling up ppe+intangibles
note_B: net acquisitions less disposals: computed flow, not a balance
adjudication_note: Both labelers ruled AGGREGATE; the disagreement is lens choice only. These are period movements (acquisitions less disposals), not balances. An asset.noncurrent lens would assert a stock rollup and conflate stock with flow; cash_flow is the only flow-shaped lens in the pre-registered list. Ruled with B, noting the lens vocabulary has no accrual-investing slot -- a limitation of the vocabulary, not of either labeler.
